title: Set up retained fishery selectivity — Setup_Mod_Retsel
text: input_list Named list containing $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists created upstream setup functions. cont_tv_ret_sel Character vector defining continuous time-varying selectivity structure per fleet. Format: "<type>_Fleet_<f>" type one : "none" time variation "iid" Independent year effects "rw" Random walk process "3dmarg" 3D marginal structure "3dcond" 3D conditional structure "2dar1" 2D AR1 structure Output mapped integer codes internally. ret_sel_blocks Character vector defining discrete selectivity blocks. Format: "none_Fleet_<f>" "Block_<b>_Year_<start>-<end>_Fleet_<f>" (terminal year version). Values expanded 3D array: [n_regions × n_years × n_fish_fleets]. ret_sel_model Character vector defining selectivity functional forms. Format: "<type>_Fleet_<f>" "<type>_Fleet_<f>_Block_<b>". Supported types: "logist1" Logistic \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) (2 parameters). "logist2" Logistic \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) (2 parameters). "gamma" Dome-shaped gamma \(a_{max}\) \(\delta\) (2 parameters). "exponential" Exponential single power parameter (1 parameter). "dbnrml" Double-normal 6 parameters. "nonpar" Non-parametric selectivity defined discrete age length bins, selectivity estimated independent parameters (grouped bins specified via nonparametric bin mapping). fixed functional form imposed. "asymplogist1" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "asymplogist2" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "bicubic" Bicubic spline bin-node x year-node grid; see ret_sel_model Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q full syntax. retsel_pe_pars_spec Specification process error parameters time-varying selectivity. Length must equal n_fish_fleets. ret_fixed_sel_pars_spec Specification controlling fixed selectivity parameters estimated vs fixed. ret_sel_devs_spec Specification annual selectivity deviations structure per fleet. ret_sel_corr_opt_semipar Optional correlation structure semi-parametric selectivity deviations. Length must equal n_fish_fleets. Use_ret_selex_prior Integer flag (0/1) indicating whether selectivity priors used. ret_selex_prior Data frame priors selectivity parameters. Must include columns: region, fleet, block, sex, par, mu, sd. retsel_devs_shared_bins Vector defining shared bins selectivity deviation estimation (e.g., age length grouping structure). ret_selex_type Character string indicating selectivity domain: "age" "length". use_fixed_ret_sel Binary indicator array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = use fixed selectivity input; 0 = estimate. ret_sel_input Fixed selectivity input array: [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × (ages lengths) × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. ret_sel_nonpar_est_bins Vector defining estimated bins non-parametric selectivity. ... Optional starting values selectivity parameters deviations.

title: Set up survey selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q
text: Configures survey selectivity catchability components estimation model: continuous blocked time-varying selectivity, selectivity functional forms, catchability blocks optional environmental covariate effects, process error deviation mapping, selectivity/catchability priors. Delegates parameter mapping four internal helpers (do_srv_fixed_sel_pars_mapping, do_srv_q_mapping, do_srvsel_pe_pars_mapping, do_srvsel_devs_mapping). Must called Setup_Mod_SrvIdx_and_Comps model compilation.

title: Set up survey selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q
code: Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q(   input_list,   cont_tv_srv_sel = paste("none_Fleet_", 1:input_list$data$n_srv_fleets, sep = ""),   srv_sel_blocks = paste("none_Fleet_", 1:input_list$data$n_srv_fleets, sep = ""),   srv_sel_model,   Use_srv_q_prior = 0,   srv_q_prior = NA,   srv_q_blocks = paste("none_Fleet_", 1:input_list$data$n_srv_fleets, sep = ""),   srvsel_pe_pars_spec = NULL,   srv_fixed_sel_pars_spec,   srv_q_spec = NULL,   srv_sel_devs_spec = NULL,   corr_opt_semipar = NULL,   srv_q_formula = NULL,   srv_q_cov_dat = NULL,   Use_srv_selex_prior = 0,   srv_selex_prior = NULL,   t_srv = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, input_list$data$n_seas,     input_list$data$n_srv_fleets)),   srvsel_devs_shared_bins = NULL,   srv_selex_type = "age",   use_fixed_srv_sel = rep(0, input_list$data$n_srv_fleets),   srv_sel_input = NULL,   srv_sel_nonpar_est_bins = NULL,   ... )

title: Set up survey selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. $data$srv_selex_type must already set Setup_Mod_Biologicals. cont_tv_srv_sel Character vector defining continuous time-variation form per fleet. element follows "<type>_Fleet_x". Options: "none" continuous time variation (default). "iid" IID deviations across years. "rw" Random walk time. "3dmarg" 3D marginal GMRF (age × year × cohort). "3dcond" 3D conditional GMRF. "2dar1" 2D AR1 (bin × year). fleet uses non-"none" type, srvsel_pe_pars_spec srv_sel_devs_spec must specified. Default: "none_Fleet_x" fleet. srv_sel_blocks Character vector defining discrete time blocks survey selectivity. element follows "Block_k_Year_a-b_Fleet_x" "none_Fleet_x" (constant selectivity). Use "terminal" place end year extend final model year. Parsed internal array [n_regions × n_years × n_srv_fleets]. Blocked continuous time-varying selectivity mutually exclusive given fleet. Default: "none_Fleet_x" fleet. srv_sel_model Character vector specifying selectivity functional form per fleet, optionally per time block. element follows one : "<model>_Fleet_x" Single form applied across years     fleet x. "<model>_Fleet_x_Block_k" Form applied block     k fleet x, defined srv_sel_blocks.     Required multiple blocks defined fleet. Available models (see model equations vignette parameterisations): "logist1" Logistic \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) (2 parameters). "logist2" Logistic \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) (2 parameters). "gamma" Dome-shaped gamma \(a_{max}\) \(\delta\) (2 parameters). "exponential" Exponential single power parameter (1 parameter). "dbnrml" Double-normal 6 parameters. "nonpar" Non-parametric selectivity defined discrete age length bins, selectivity estimated independent parameters (grouped bins specified via nonparametric bin mapping). fixed functional form imposed. "asymplogist1" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "asymplogist2" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "bicubic" Bicubic spline bin-node x year-node grid     (see Get_Selex, Selex_Model == 8). Specified     "bicubic_Bin_<n_bin_nodes>_Yr_<n_yr_nodes>_Fleet_x" (optionally     _Block_k). One generalized form covers smooth bin x year     surface (n_yr_nodes > 1), time-invariant bin-spline     (n_yr_nodes == 1), bin-spline re-fit independently     per year-block (n_yr_nodes == 1 within several blocks     defined via srv_sel_blocks). optional _SelStyr_<year>     suffix (calendar year within block) restricts actual spline     fit SelStyr:block-end; years within block     SelStyr held constant SelStyr year's fitted     curve, rather fitting surface whole block.     optional _NSelBins_<n> suffix restricts actual spline fit     first n bins (ages lengths, per srv_selex_type);     bins beyond n held constant last fitted bin's     curve. default; must provided. Use_srv_q_prior Integer (0/1). Whether log-normal priors applied survey catchability parameters. Default 0. srv_q_prior Data frame catchability prior specifications. Required columns: region, fleet, block, mu (prior mean natural scale), sd (prior SD log scale). row specifies \(\log\text{N}(\log(\mu), \text{sd})\) prior. Ignored Use_srv_q_prior = 0. Default NA. srv_q_blocks Character vector defining discrete time blocks survey catchability. format srv_sel_blocks: "Block_k_Year_a-b_Fleet_x" "none_Fleet_x". Parsed array [n_regions × n_years × n_srv_fleets]. Default: "none_Fleet_x" fleet. srvsel_pe_pars_spec Character vector [n_srv_fleets] NULL. Sharing structure process error hyperparameters. See do_srvsel_pe_pars_mapping full option descriptions. Default NULL. srv_fixed_sel_pars_spec Character vector [n_srv_fleets]. Sharing structure fixed-effect selectivity parameters. See do_srv_fixed_sel_pars_mapping full option descriptions. default; must provided. srv_q_spec Character vector [n_srv_fleets] NULL. Sharing structure catchability. See do_srv_q_mapping full option descriptions. Default NULL. srv_sel_devs_spec Character vector [n_srv_fleets] NULL. Sharing structure selectivity deviation time series. See do_srvsel_devs_mapping full option descriptions. Default NULL. corr_opt_semipar Character vector [n_srv_fleets] NULL. Specifies correlation components suppress 3D GMRF 2D AR1 forms. See do_srvsel_pe_pars_mapping valid values. Default NULL. srv_q_formula Named list R formulas specifying environmental covariate relationships catchability per region–fleet combination. Names follow convention "Region_r_Fleet_f". Covariates must present srv_q_cov_dat. NULL, covariate effects included. Default NULL. srv_q_cov_dat Named list numeric vectors (length = n_years) containing covariate time series referenced srv_q_formula. vectors must length contain missing values; set values 0 years survey active. NULL, covariate effects excluded. Default NULL. Use_srv_selex_prior Integer (0/1). Whether log-normal priors applied survey selectivity parameters. Default 0. srv_selex_prior Data frame selectivity prior specifications. Required columns: region, fleet, block, sex, par, mu, sd. Ignored Use_srv_selex_prior = 0. Default NULL. t_srv Survey timing fraction within given year (annual models) season (seasonal models), array [n_regions × n_seas × n_srv_fleets]. Default: 1 (end period). srvsel_devs_shared_bins List integer vectors defining bin groups age/length-sharing deviations semi-parametric forms (e.g., list(1:5, 6:10, 11:30)). Required srv_sel_devs_spec includes "est_shared_b" variant. Default NULL. srv_selex_type Character. Whether survey selectivity type 'age' 'length' based. Default: age. use_fixed_srv_sel Integer vector length n_srv_fleets indicating whether survey selectivity fixed (1) estimated (0) survey index. srv_sel_input Array fixed survey selectivity values used use_fixed_srv_sel == 1. Dimensions: [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_bins × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Required whenever survey fixed selectivity specified. srv_sel_nonpar_est_bins Optional list defining bin groupings non-parametric survey selectivity. Structure [[survey]][[block]], element list integer vectors. vector defines group bins share single estimated selectivity parameter. Indices must correspond bin dimension defined survey selectivity type (age length). ... Optional named starting values selectivity catchability parameters.

what: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
text: Configures conventional tagging components estimation model: tag release cohort definitions, recapture data, tag recapture likelihood, mixing period, release platform, dimension-attendance pooling structure, reporting rate time blocks sharing, optional reporting rate priors. Delegates parameter mapping four internal helpers (do_conv_init_tag_mort_mapping, do_conv_tag_shed_mapping, do_conv_tag_theta_mapping, do_conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars_mapping). Must called Setup_Mod_Dim model compilation.

title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
code: Setup_Mod_Tagging(   input_list,   use_conv_fish_tagging = rep(0, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets),   conv_tag_release_indicator = NULL,   conv_tag_max_liberty = 0,   conv_tagged_fish = NA,   obs_conv_tag_fish_recap = NA,   conv_fish_tag_like = NA,   conv_tag_mixing_period = 1,   conv_tag_t_tagging = 1,   use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior = 0,   conv_tag_fishrep_prior = NULL,   conv_tag_pop_pool = as.list(1:input_list$data$n_pop),   conv_tag_age_pool = as.list(1:length(input_list$data$ages)),   conv_tag_sex_pool = as.list(1:input_list$data$n_sexes),   init_conv_tag_mort_spec = NULL,   conv_tag_shed_spec = NULL,   conv_tagrep_spec = "fix",   conv_tag_fish_reporting_blocks = NULL,   conv_fish_tag_attr = "p_a_s",   conv_tag_release_platform = NULL,   ... )

title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. use_conv_fish_tagging Integer vector [n_fish_fleets] (0/1). Whether conventional tagging data included likelihood fishery fleet. Default: 0 fleets. conv_tag_release_indicator Integer matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 3] giving release region, year, season tag cohort. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Default NULL. conv_tag_max_liberty Integer. Maximum years--liberty included likelihood; recaptures beyond horizon ignored. Must \(> 0\) tagging active. Default 0. conv_tagged_fish Array [n_conv_tag_cohorts × n_pop × n_ages × n_sexes] tagged fish released per cohort. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Dimensions attended conv_fish_tag_attr fish placed index 1 remaining indices set zero. Default NA. obs_conv_tag_fish_recap Array observed recaptures [conv_tag_max_liberty × n_seas × n_conv_tag_cohorts × n_pop × n_regions × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Default NA. conv_fish_tag_like Character string specifying tag recapture likelihood. One "Poisson", "NegBin", "Multinomial_Release", "Multinomial_Recapture", "Dirichlet-Multinomial_Release", "Dirichlet-Multinomial_Recapture". Converted integer codes (0–5) storage. Default NA. conv_tag_mixing_period Integer. Minimum number years (seasons seasonal models) post-release recaptures contribute likelihood. Allows time tags mix within population informing movement estimation. Default 1. conv_tag_t_tagging Numeric scalar \([0, 1]\). Fraction season remaining tag release. 1 = start season; 0.5 = mid-season; 0 = end season. Default 1. use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior Integer (0/1). Whether priors applied reporting rate parameters. Default 0. conv_tag_fishrep_prior Data frame prior specifications reporting rates. Required columns: region, block, fleet, mu, sd, type. Ignored use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior = 0. Default NULL. conv_tag_pop_pool List integer vectors defining population pooling groups tagging likelihood. "p" attended conv_fish_tag_attr, use list(1:n_pop). pooling structure inconsistent conv_fish_tag_attr, warning issued structure automatically overridden single group. Default: .list(1:n_pop) (population-specific). conv_tag_age_pool List integer vectors defining age pooling groups. "" attended, use list(1:n_ages). Custom groupings (e.g., list(1:5, 6:10)) supported "" attended. Default: .list(1:n_ages). conv_tag_sex_pool List integer vectors defining sex pooling groups. "s" attended, use list(1:n_sexes). Default: .list(1:n_sexes). init_conv_tag_mort_spec Character string ("fix" "est"). Whether initial tag-induced mortality fixed starting value estimated. See do_conv_init_tag_mort_mapping. Default NULL. conv_tag_shed_spec Character string ("fix" "est"). Whether chronic tag shedding fixed estimated. See do_conv_tag_shed_mapping. Default NULL. conv_tagrep_spec Character string. Sharing structure reporting rate parameters conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars [n_regions × max_tagrep_blocks × n_fish_fleets]. See do_conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars_mapping full option descriptions. Default "fix" (warning issued unintentional). conv_tag_fish_reporting_blocks Character vector defining time blocks fishery tag reporting rates. element follows one : "none_Region_r_Fleet_f" Constant reporting rate     region r fleet f. "Block_b_Year_y1-y2_Region_r_Fleet_f" Block b     applies years y1–y2. Use "terminal"     end year extend final model year. Parsed array [n_regions × n_years × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, single constant block used region–fleet combinations. Default NULL. conv_fish_tag_attr Character string specifying biological dimensions attended (resolved) recapture likelihood. Built combination "p" (population), "" (age), "s" (sex), joined underscores. Region fleet always retained. dimension attended, released recaptured fish must placed index 1 dimension, corresponding pooling argument must pool indices single group. likelihood marginalises unattended dimension. Valid values: "p_a_s", "a_s", "p_a", "p_s", "", "s", "p", "none". Default "p_a_s". conv_tag_release_platform Character matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 2] specifying release platform fleet index per cohort. format Setup_Sim_Tagging. Default NULL. ... Optional named starting values parameters. Supported names defaults: ln_init_conv_tag_mort (scalar, default -1000), ln_conv_tag_shed (scalar, default -1000), ln_conv_fish_tag_theta (scalar, default 0), conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars   [n_regions × max_tagrep_blocks × n_fish_fleets], default 0 (logit scale ≈ 0.5 reporting probability; inactive fleet slots overwritten -1000).

title: Set likelihood and penalty weights for the estimation model — Setup_Mod_Weighting
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. Wt_Catch Weight applied catch likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly across fleets, regions, years, seasons, numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets] fleet- time-specific weighting. Default 1. Wt_FishIdx Weight applied fishery index likelihood. Accepts scalar array format Wt_Catch, dimensioned [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_SrvIdx Weight applied survey index likelihood. Accepts scalar array format, dimensioned [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_srv_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Catch_pop Weight applied population-specific catch likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_FishIdx_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery index likelihood. scalar array format Wt_Catch_pop, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_SrvIdx_pop Weight applied population-specific survey index likelihood. scalar array format Wt_Catch_pop, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_srv_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Rec Scalar weight applied recruitment deviation penalty (ln_RecDevs). Default 1. Wt_F Scalar weight applied fishing mortality deviation penalty (ln_F_devs). Default 1. Wt_Tagging Scalar weight applied tag-recovery likelihood. Default 1. Wt_FishAgeComps Weight applied fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvAgeComps Weight applied survey age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps Weight applied fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvLenComps Weight applied survey length composition likelihood. format Wt_SrvAgeComps, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishAgeComps_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvAgeComps_pop Weight applied population-specific survey age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvLenComps_pop Weight applied population-specific survey length composition likelihood. format Wt_SrvAgeComps_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_Discard Weight applied aggregated discard amount fraction likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_D Scalar weight applied discard mortality rate deviation penalty (logit_dmr_devs). Default 1. Wt_FishAgeComps_discard Weight applied discard fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_discard Weight applied discard fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_discard, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishAgeComps_discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_discard_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. fish_sel_pen_wts NULL (default), named numeric vector/list independent weights subset six selectivity smoothness penalty terms (see resolve_sel_pen_wts Get_Selex_Smoothness_Penalty), evaluated directly fleet's realized selectivity--bin--year surface applicable selectivity functional form: "smooth_bin_curve" Second-difference (curvature) penalty across bins. "smooth_bin_diff" Unconditional first-difference penalty across bins. "smooth_yr_diff" First-difference penalty across years. "smooth_yr_curve" Second-difference (curvature) penalty across years. "smooth_dome" Dome-shape (non-monotonicity) penalty across bins. "smooth_mean_center" Per-year mean-centering regularization. name supplied defaults 0 (). Must called Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q. ret_sel_pen_wts format fish_sel_pen_wts, retained fishery selectivity penalty. srv_sel_pen_wts format fish_sel_pen_wts, survey selectivity penalty. Must called Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q.

title: Set up biological parameter inputs for closed-loop simulation — Setup_Sim_Biologicals
text: sim_list Simulation list object returned Setup_Sim_Dim, defines dimension sizes used validate input arrays. natmort_input Natural mortality array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Note: natural mortality season-specific therefore lacks n_seas dimension. WAA_input Spawning weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Used compute spawning stock biomass. WAA_fish_input Fishery weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets × n_sims]. Used compute fishery biomass catch weight. WAA_srv_input Survey weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets × n_sims]. Used compute survey biomass indices. MatAA_input Maturity--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Values proportions \([0, 1]\). rec_lag = 0 (age-0 recruitment, set via Setup_Sim_Rec), maturity recruit age (first age class) must exactly 0 populations, regions, years, seasons, sexes – error raised otherwise. AgeingError_input Ageing error (age-length transition) array dimensions [n_yrs × n_model_ages × n_obs_ages × n_sims], [n_model_ages × n_obs_ages] slice row-stochastic matrix mapping true modelled ages observed age bins. NULL (default), identity matrix constructed year simulation, assumes modelled observed age bins identical number alignment. observed age bins subset modelled ages (e.g., observed ages 2–10 vs. modelled ages 1–10), default identity matrix cause dimensional mismatch. case, supply shifted identity matrix diag(1, n_model_ages)[, obs_age_index] correctly drop collapse model ages observed bins. SizeAgeTrans_input Size-age transition matrix array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_lens × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. slice maps age classes length bins column-stochastic (columns sum 1). required fitting length compositions; defaults NULL.

code: Setup_Sim_Dim(   n_sims,   n_yrs,   n_pop = 1,   n_seas = 1,   n_regions,   natal_region = NULL,   n_ages,   n_lens = NULL,   n_obs_ages = n_ages,   n_sexes,   n_fish_fleets,   n_srv_fleets,   seasdur = if (n_seas == 1) 1 else rep(1/n_seas, n_seas),   run_feedback = FALSE,   feedback_start_yr = NULL )

title: Initialise simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
text: n_sims Positive integer. Number simulation replicates. n_yrs Positive integer. Number projection years. n_pop Positive integer. Number distinct populations (default 1). Populations share movement selectivity schedules can independent stock-recruit relationships natal regions. n_seas Positive integer. Number seasons within year (default 1). n_regions Positive integer. Number spatial regions. natal_region Integer vector length n_pop mapping population natal region (1-indexed). Defaults applied NULL: n_regions == 1: populations assigned region 1. n_pop == n_regions: one--one mapping (1:n_pop). n_pop == 1: assigned region 1. Must supplied explicitly n_pop > 1, n_pop != n_regions, n_regions > 1, multiple populations share natal region sensible default exists. n_ages Positive integer. Number modelled age classes. n_lens Positive integer. Number length bins. Set NULL (default) length compositions simulated. n_obs_ages Positive integer. Number observed age bins composition data. Can differ n_ages plus group youngest ages pooled differently observations. Defaults n_ages. n_sexes Integer. Number sexes; must either 1 (sex-aggregated) 2 (sex-structured). n_fish_fleets Positive integer. Number fishery fleets. n_srv_fleets Positive integer. Number survey fleets. seasdur Numeric vector length n_seas giving duration season fraction year. Values must sum 1. Defaults 1 n_seas == 1, rep(1 / n_seas, n_seas) equal-length seasons otherwise. run_feedback Logical. Whether run closed-loop feedback MSE estimation model harvest control rule update fishing mortality year. Default FALSE (open-loop simulation). feedback_start_yr Integer. First year feedback applied. Required run_feedback = TRUE; ignored otherwise.

title: Initialise simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
text: named list (sim_list) containing: n_sims, n_yrs, n_pop, n_regions,       n_seas, n_ages, n_obs_ages, n_lens,       n_sexes, n_fish_fleets, n_srv_fleets Dimension scalars supplied inputs. natal_region Integer vector length n_pop       defining natal regions. seasdur Season durations summing 1. init_iter Derived value n_ages * 10 used initialise       equilibrium conditions. run_feedback, feedback_start_yr Feedback control settings.

title: Setup Simulation Fishing Inputs — Setup_Sim_Fishing
text: sim_list list containing simulation settings, including number populations (`n_pop`), regions (`n_regions`), years (`n_yrs`), seasons (`n_seas`), ages (`n_ages`), sexes (`n_sexes`), fishing fleets (`n_fish_fleets`), simulations (`n_sims`). ln_sigmaC Numeric array. Log-scale observation SD total catch, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(0.02). ln_sigmaC_pop Numeric array. Log-scale observation SD population-specific catch, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(0.02). catch_units Numeric vector. Catch units (0 = abundance, 1 = biomass), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 1. init_F_val Numeric array. Initial fishing mortality, dimensions `n_regions x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. Fmort_input Numeric array. Fishing mortality, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 0.1. fish_sel_input Numeric array. Fishery selectivity, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_ages x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. fish_q_input Numeric array. Catchability, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 1. ObsFishIdx_SE Numeric array. Observation SD fishery indices, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.2. ObsFishIdx_pop_SE Numeric array. Observation SD population-specific fishery indices, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.2. fish_idx_type Numeric array. Index type (0 = abundance, 1 = biomass), dimensions `n_regions x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 1. comp_fishage_like Numeric vector. Likelihood age composition (0 = Multinomial, 1 = Dirichlet-Multinomial, 2–4 = Logistic-Normal variants), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. ISS_FishAgeComps Numeric array. Effective sample sizes age compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 100. ln_FishAge_theta Numeric array. Log-scale overdispersion fishery age compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(1). ln_FishAge_theta_agg Numeric vector. Aggregated log-scale overdispersion fishery age compositions, length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(1). FishAge_corr_pars_agg Numeric vector. Aggregated correlation parameters fishery age compositions, length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.01. FishAge_corr_pars Numeric array. Correlation parameters fishery age compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x 2`. Default: 0.01. FishAgeComps_Type Numeric array. Composition structure fishery age compositions (0 = aggregated, 1 = split region/sex, 2 = split region joint sex, 999 = none), dimensions `n_yrs x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 2. comp_fishlen_like Numeric vector. Likelihood length composition (0 = Multinomial, 1 = Dirichlet-Multinomial, 2–4 = Logistic-Normal variants), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. ISS_FishLenComps Numeric array. Effective sample sizes length compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 100. ln_FishLen_theta Numeric array. Log-scale overdispersion fishery length compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(1). ln_FishLen_theta_agg Numeric vector. Aggregated log-scale overdispersion fishery length compositions, length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(1). FishLen_corr_pars_agg Numeric vector. Aggregated correlation parameters fishery length compositions, length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.01. FishLen_corr_pars Numeric array. Correlation parameters fishery length compositions, dimensions `n_regions x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x 2`. Default: 0.01. FishLenComps_Type Numeric array. Composition structure fishery length compositions (0 = aggregated, 1 = split region/sex, 2 = split region joint sex, 999 = none), dimensions `n_yrs x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 2. comp_fishage_pop_like Numeric vector. Likelihood population-specific fishery age composition (0 = Multinomial, 1 = Dirichlet-Multinomial, 2–4 = Logistic-Normal variants), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. title: Set up recruitment dynamics for the operating model simulation — Setup_Sim_Rec
text: Populates sim_list recruitment-related inputs needed operating model: stock-recruit relationship type density-dependence structure, biological parameters (\(R_0\), steepness, sex ratio), recruitment initial age-structure deviations, seasonal recruitment allocation, spawn timing, equilibrium initialisation method. Must called Setup_Sim_Dim.

title: Set up recruitment dynamics for the operating model simulation — Setup_Sim_Rec
code: Setup_Sim_Rec(   sim_list,   do_recruits_move = 0,   sexratio_input = array(if (sim_list$n_sexes == 1) 1 else 0.5, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop,     sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_yrs, sim_list$n_sexes, sim_list$n_sims)),   R0_input = array(15, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_yrs,     sim_list$n_sims)),   rinit_input = array(15, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_sims)),   h_input = array(0.8, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_yrs,     sim_list$n_sims)),   stray_rate_input = array(0, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_yrs, sim_list$n_sims)),   ln_sigmaR = array(log(1), dim = c(2, sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions)),   rec_seas_prop_input = {      rec_seas_prop = array(0, dim = c(sim_list$n_pop,     sim_list$n_seas, sim_list$n_sims)) rec_seas_prop[, 1, ] <- 1      rec_seas_prop      },   recruitment_opt = "bh_rec",   rec_dd = "global",   init_dd = "global",   use_rinit = 0,   init_age_strc = 2,   spawn_seas = 1,   t_spawn = 0,   rec_lag = 1,   Rec_input = NULL,   ln_InitDevs_input = NULL )

title: Set up recruitment dynamics for the operating model simulation — Setup_Sim_Rec
text: sim_list Simulation list returned Setup_Sim_Dim. do_recruits_move Integer flag. 0 = age-1 fish move (default); movement begins age 2. 1 = recruits participate movement age 1. sexratio_input Proportion recruits assigned sex, array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sexes x n_sims]. Default: 1 n_sexes = 1; 0.5 per sex n_sexes = 2. R0_input Unfished equilibrium recruitment array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sims]. Default: 15 cells. rinit_input Unfished equilibrium recruitment scalar used population initialisation use_rinit = 1, array [n_pop x n_regions x n_sims]. Ignored use_rinit = 0. Default: 15 cells. h_input Beverton-Holt steepness array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sims]. Values \((0.2, 1)\). Default: 0.8. stray_rate_input Natal-homing stray rate array [n_pop x n_yrs x n_sims]. Proportion individuals stray natal region spawning. Default: 0 (individuals stray). ln_sigmaR Log-scale standard deviation recruitment deviations, array [2 x n_pop x n_regions]. first element controls SD initial age-structure deviations (ln_InitDevs); second controls SD annual recruitment deviations (ln_RecDevs). Default: log(1) . rec_seas_prop_input Seasonal allocation annual recruitment, array [n_pop x n_seas x n_sims]. population's values sum 1 across seasons. Default: recruitment assigned season 1. rec_lag = 0 spawn_seas > 1, must zero every season spawn_seas – error raised otherwise. recruitment_opt Recruitment model. Default "bh_rec". Options: 0/"mean_rec" Mean recruitment; stock-recruit     relationship. 1/"bh_rec" Beverton-Holt stock-recruit relationship.     Requires rec_dd = "local" n_pop > 1. 999/"resample_from_input" Bootstrap recruitment     resampling years Rec_input. Historical years used     -; projection years sampled replacement, preserving     spatial covariance among regions within resampled year.     Requires Rec_input non-NULL. rec_dd Density-dependence structure stock-recruit relationship. Default "global". Options: 0/"local" Region-specific spawner-recruit     relationship; region \(R_0\) steepness.     Required n_pop > 1 recruitment_opt = "bh_rec". 1/"global" Single shared spawner-recruit     relationship pooled across regions. init_dd Density-dependence structure equilibrium age-structure initialisation. Default "global". options rec_dd. use_rinit Integer (0/1). Whether separate initial recruitment scalar rinit_input used initialise population independently R0_input. 0 (default), rinit_input ignored R0_input governs initialisation recruitment. 1, rinit_input used exclusively equilibrium initialisation R0_input governs recruitment relationship. init_age_strc Integer specifying equilibrium age-structure initialisation method. Default 2. Options: 0/"iterative" Iterates population forward     approximate equilibrium. Slowest general. 1/"scalar_no_move" Scalar geometric series solution     assuming movement age class. 2/"matrix" Matrix geometric series solution     generalises scalar approach include movement. Recommended     default spatially explicit models. 3/"scalar_plus_only" Scalar geometric series     solution assuming movement except plus group. spawn_seas Integer index season spawning occurs. Default 1. t_spawn Spawn timing fraction season elapsed spawning within spawn_seas. 0 (default) = spawning occurs mortality applied season; 1 = spawning occurs mortality. rec_lag Integer. Number seasons spawning recruitment. 1 (default) classic lagged case: recruits enter population using SSB rec_lag seasons prior, season. 0 age-0 recruitment: recruits enter using year's SSB. SSB known spawn_seas reached, age-0 recruits may enter spawn_seas later season year – rec_seas_prop_input must zero every season spawn_seas rec_lag = 0. Rec_input External recruitment array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sims]. Required recruitment_opt = "resample_from_input"; projection years beyond length Rec_input filled resampling historical years replacement. Ignored recruitment options. Default NULL. ln_InitDevs_input Optional log-scale initial age-structure deviations array [n_pop x n_regions x (n_ages - 1) x n_sims]. n_ages - 1 dimension excludes reference age used initialisation. NULL (default), deviations initialised zero.

title: Set up conventional tagging dynamics for the operating model simulation — Setup_Sim_Tagging
text: sim_list Simulation list returned Setup_Sim_Dim. n_tags Numeric scalar. Constant number tags released per release event. specified simultaneously n_tags_rel_input. Default NULL. n_tags_rel_input Array specifying cohort-specific tag release numbers (e.g., varying length, age, structure). Overrides n_tags supplied. specified simultaneously n_tags. Default NULL. use_conv_fish_tagging Integer (0/1). Whether conventional tag recaptures fisheries simulated. Default 0. conv_tag_max_liberty Integer. Maximum number years--liberty tracked per tag cohort. Controls size recapture containers. Default: n_ages / 2. conv_tag_release_indicator Data frame defining tag release cohorts. Required columns: regions (release region), tag_years (release year), tag_seas (release season). Default: combinations regions, years, seasons sim_list. conv_tag_release_platform Character matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 2] specifying release platform associated fleet index cohort. Rows must align conv_tag_release_indicator. Column platform must one : "population" Tags released directly population,     independent fleet survey sampling process.     fleet column NA. "fishery" Tags released fishery fleet.     fleet column gives fleet index. "survey" Tags released survey fleet.     fleet column gives fleet index. Default: "survey" platform fleet 1 every cohort. conv_tag_t_tagging Numeric scalar \([0, 1]\). Fraction season remaining time tag release. 1 = start season; 0.5 = mid-season; 0 = end season. Default 1. ln_init_conv_tag_mort Log-scale initial tag-induced mortality applied moment release. Default -1000 (approximately zero mortality). ln_conv_tag_shed Log-scale annual chronic tag shedding rate. Default -1000 (approximately shedding). conv_fish_tag_attr Character string specifying biological dimensions retained recapture. Built combination "p" (population), "" (age), "s" (sex), joined underscores. Region fleet always retained. Valid values: "p_a_s", "a_s", "p_a", "p_s", "", "s", "p", "none". Default "p_a_s". conv_tag_fish_reporting_input Fishery tag reporting rate array [n_regions × n_yrs × n_fish_fleets × n_sims]. Values represent probability recaptured tag reported must \([0, 1]\). Default: 0.5 cells. conv_fish_tag_like Integer character scalar specifying tag recapture likelihood. Default 0 (Poisson). Options: 0/"Poisson" Poisson. 1/"NegBin" Negative binomial. 2/"Multinomial_Release" Multinomial conditioned     releases. 3/"Multinomial_Recapture" Multinomial conditioned     recaptures. 4/"Dirichlet-Multinomial_Release" Dirichlet-multinomial     conditioned releases. 5/"Dirichlet-Multinomial_Recapture" Dirichlet-multinomial     conditioned recaptures. ln_conv_fish_tag_theta Log-scale overdispersion parameter negative-binomial (1) Dirichlet-multinomial (4, 5) likelihoods. Ignored Poisson multinomial likelihoods. Default log(1).

what: Convert target catches to fishing mortality rates for multiple fleets — catch_to_F_multifleet
title: Convert target catches to fishing mortality rates for multiple fleets — catch_to_F_multifleet
text: Solves vector fleet-specific fishing mortality rates \(\mathbf{F} = (F_1, \ldots, F_k)\) simultaneously satisfy Baranov catch equations fleets, given vector target catches. Total mortality age accounts retained discard mortality contributions fleets: \(Z_a = M_a + \sum_f (F_f \, s_{,f} \, r_{,f} + F_f \, s_{,f} \, (1 - r_{,f}) \, d_f)\), \(r_{,f}\) retention selectivity \(d_f\) fleet-specific discard mortality. system equations solved via nleqslv. Intended closed-loop MSE harvest control rules multiple interacting fishery fleets.

title: Convert target catches to fishing mortality rates for multiple fleets — catch_to_F_multifleet
code: catch_to_F_multifleet(   target_catch,   NAA,   WAA,   natmort,   fish_sel,   ret_sel = array(1, dim = dim(fish_sel)),   dmr = rep(0, length(target_catch)),   f_init = 0.05,   control = list(btol = 1e-06) )

title: Convert target catches to fishing mortality rates for multiple fleets — catch_to_F_multifleet
text: target_catch Numeric vector [n_fleets]. Target catch biomass units fleet. NAA Numeric matrix [n_ages x n_sexes]. Numbers--age. WAA Numeric matrix [n_ages x n_sexes]. Weight--age. natmort Numeric matrix [n_ages x n_sexes]. Instantaneous natural mortality rate. fish_sel Numeric array [n_ages x n_sexes x n_fleets]. Fishery selectivity fleet. ret_sel Numeric array [n_ages x n_sexes x n_fleets]. Retention selectivity fleet, .e. proportion selected catch retained. Default array 1s matching dim(fish_sel) (full retention fleets). dmr Numeric vector [n_fleets]. Fleet-specific discard mortality rates, .e. fraction discarded fish die. Default rep(0, length(target_catch)) (discards survive). f_init Numeric scalar vector [n_fleets]. Starting values \(F\) solver. scalar supplied recycled across fleets. Default 0.05. control Named list control parameters passed nleqslv. Default list(btol = 1e-6).

title: Convert target catches to fishing mortality rates for multiple fleets — catch_to_F_multifleet
text: Numeric vector [n_fleets] solved fishing mortality rates,   one per fleet.

Historical years conditioned outputs fitted assessment model, projection years initialized using extension rules user-supplied overrides. what: Evaluate a symmetric beta log-density — dbeta_symmetric
title: Evaluate a symmetric beta log-density — dbeta_symmetric
text: Computes log-density penalises parameter value toward midpoint [p_lb, p_ub] using symmetric beta-like kernel. penalty strengthens p_prsd increases diffuses p_prsd decreases. Used SPoRC prior tag reporting rates discourage values near boundaries unit interval.

title: Evaluate a symmetric beta log-density — dbeta_symmetric
code: dbeta_symmetric(p_val, p_ub, p_lb, p_prsd, log = TRUE)

title: Evaluate a symmetric beta log-density — dbeta_symmetric
text: p_val Numeric. Parameter value evaluate; must lie (p_lb, p_ub). p_ub Numeric. Upper bound parameter support. p_lb Numeric. Lower bound parameter support. p_prsd Numeric. Pseudo-standard-deviation controlling prior concentration. Larger values produce stronger penalty toward midpoint \((p_{ub} + p_{lb}) / 2\); smaller values produce diffuse prior. log Logical. TRUE (default), returns log-density; otherwise returns density probability scale.

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet log-density — ddirichlet
text: Computes Dirichlet log-density \(\log \Gamma(\sum \alpha) - \sum \log \Gamma(\alpha_k) + \sum (\alpha_k - 1) \log x_k\) compositional vector x concentration parameter vector alpha. Used SPoRC prior movement rates recruitment regional apportionment.

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet log-density — ddirichlet
code: ddirichlet(x, alpha, log = TRUE)

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet log-density — ddirichlet
text: x Numeric vector compositional values summing 1; elements must strictly positive. alpha Numeric vector Dirichlet concentration parameters length x. Larger values \(\sum \alpha\) concentrate mass near \(\alpha / \sum \alpha\). log Logical. TRUE (default), returns log-density; otherwise returns density.

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet log-density — ddirichlet
text: Numeric. Log-density (density log = FALSE).

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet-multinomial log-likelihood — ddirmult
text: Computes Dirichlet-multinomial log-likelihood following parameterisation Thorson et al. (CCSRA). concentration parameters \(\alpha_k = \exp(\ln\theta) \times N \times \hat{p}_k\), \(\exp(\ln\theta)\) per-observation overdispersion scalar: values near zero approach multinomial larger values increase variance. Non-integer observed counts supported via lgamma.

title: Evaluate a Dirichlet-multinomial log-likelihood — ddirmult

Total count (input sample size \(N\)). ln_theta Numeric. Log overdispersion parameter. Dirichlet concentration \(\exp(\ln\theta) \times N \times \hat{p}_k\). give_log Logical. TRUE (default), returns log-likelihood; otherwise returns likelihood.

text: Internal helper called Setup_Mod_Rec construct TMB/RTMB factor map ln_InitDevs, log-scale deviations equilibrium initial age structure. ln_InitDevs array dimensions [n_pop x n_regions x (n_ages - 1)], age dimension excludes plus group default (see equil_init_age_strc ).

title: Map initial age-structure deviation parameters — do_InitDevs_mapping
code: do_InitDevs_mapping(input_list, InitDevs_spec, rec_dd, init_age_devs_shared)

title: Map initial age-structure deviation parameters — do_InitDevs_mapping
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map sublists. Requires $data$equil_init_age_strc, $data$rec_region_prop_spec, $data$natal_region, $data$rec_dd set upstream setup functions. InitDevs_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_InitDevs, NULL estimate deviations independently across dimensions. Options non-NULL: "est_shared_pop_r" single set age-specific deviations     shared across populations regions. age class receives one     estimated parameter regardless many populations regions     modelled. Required rec_dd = "global"     n_regions > 1. "est_shared_r" Separate age-specific deviations per     population, shared across regions within population. Regions     within population constrained identical initial     age structure. Also valid global density dependence. "fix" ln_InitDevs parameters fixed zero     (mapped NA). Equivalent assuming fully deterministic     initial age structure. NULL Estimate deviations independently across     populations, regions, ages. permitted     rec_region_prop_spec = 1 n_pop > 1, non-natal     regions recruitment. rec_dd Recruitment density-dependence structure inherited Setup_Mod_Rec. "global" restricts valid InitDevs_spec choices "est_shared_r" "est_shared_pop_r" n_regions > 1. init_age_devs_shared Integer vector length n_ages - 1 specifying explicit parameter-sharing structure ln_InitDevs along age dimension. element gives factor level assigned age position; positions sharing integer value constrained single estimated parameter. Used conjunction equil_init_age_strc = 3 ("stoch_shared_ages"), activates user-defined age sharing still estimating deviations independently across populations regions. sharing structure also respected InitDevs_spec options: "est_shared_r" applies vector per population (population-level offset pops remain independent), "est_shared_pop_r" applies globally (offset, pops regions share parameters). typical use case replicating ADMB models ages beyond data plus group share last estimated deviation, e.g. c(1:42, rep(42, 9)) 52-age model 43 data ages, giving 42 free parameters. NULL (default), age sharing follows standard behaviour determined equil_init_age_strc alone.

title: Map initial age-structure deviation parameters — do_InitDevs_mapping
text: input input_list $map$ln_InitDevs set   factor vector length prod(dim(par$ln_InitDevs)). Active   parameters receive sequential integer indices; plus-group slots (  equil_init_age_strc = 1) non-natal region slots (  rec_region_prop_spec = 1) NA. Starting values   $par$ln_InitDevs also reset 0 fixed cells.

title: Map initial age-structure deviation parameters — do_InitDevs_mapping
text: Mapping behaviour governed three interacting considerations: Equilibrium initialisation (equil_init_age_strc):     0, deviations fixed zero (stochastic initial     structure). 1, plus-group deviations fixed     remaining ages estimated shared. 2, ages including     plus group receive stochastic deviations. Sharing specification (InitDevs_spec): controls     whether deviations shared across regions /populations. -dispersal constraint: rec_region_prop_spec = 1     n_pop > 1, non-natal regions receive recruitment     initial age deviations structurally zero; automatically     fixed NA regardless InitDevs_spec, remaining     indices re-numbered sequentially.

what: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma
title: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma
text: Builds covariance matrix \(\Sigma\) used logistic-normal composition likelihoods given correlation structure. Three structures supported, matching comp_like codes used throughout SPoRC: iid (2), AR(1) across bins (3), AR(1) across bins constant correlation across sexes via Kronecker product (4).

title: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma

title: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma
text: comp_like Integer. Covariance structure: 2 = iid (diagonal \(\theta^2 \)), 3 = AR(1) across bins (\(\theta^2 C_{\text{AR1}}\)), 4 = Kronecker product constant sex correlation AR(1) bin correlation (\(\theta^2 (C_{\text{sex}} \otimes C_{\text{AR1}})\)). n_bins Integer. Number composition categories (ages lengths). resulting matrix dimension n_bins comp_like 2 3, n_bins × n_sexes comp_like = 4. n_sexes Integer. Number sexes. Required comp_like = 4; ignored otherwise. theta Numeric. Marginal standard deviation \(\theta > 0\) controlling overall scale \(\Sigma\). corr_b Numeric. AR(1) correlation across bins \((-1, 1)\). Required comp_like 3 4; ignored comp_like = 2. corr_s Numeric. Constant (exchangeable) correlation across sexes \((-1, 1)\). Required comp_like = 4; ignored otherwise.

title: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma
text: Numeric covariance matrix \(\Sigma\) dimension   n_bins × n_bins (comp_like 2, 3)   (n_bins × n_sexes) × (n_bins × n_sexes) (comp_like = 4).

title: Construct a logistic-normal covariance matrix — get_logistN_Sigma
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # iid get_logistN_Sigma(comp_like = 2, n_bins = 5, n_sexes = NULL, theta = 0.5)  # AR(1) across bins get_logistN_Sigma(comp_like = 3, n_bins = 5, n_sexes = NULL,                   theta = 0.5, corr_b = 0.3)  # AR(1) across bins x constant across sexes get_logistN_Sigma(comp_like = 4, n_bins = 5, n_sexes = 2,                   theta = 0.5, corr_b = 0.3, corr_s = 0.2) } # }

title: Compute local Beverton-Holt Fmsy for a spatially explicit multi-population model — local_BH_Fmsy_multipop
text: Cohorts tracked using per-recruit framework indexed [population x origin x destination x age x season]. Recruitment distributed across seasons (rec_seas_prop), regions (rec_region_prop), sex (sex_ratio_f). Initial recruits assigned first season age-1, additional seasonal recruitment contributions added within first age class prior movement mortality. Movement applied seasonal step using region- age-specific transition matrices. Fishing mortality decomposed retained discarded components, total mortality applied continuously within season. Catch--age accumulated across fleets, seasons, regions using landed fraction fishing mortality (excluding fleets flagged discard-via is_discard_fleet), total mortality Z includes fleets. Spawning biomass per recruit (SBPR) computed spawning season applying movement partial mortality spawning time (t_spawn). single-season models multiple populations, sgl_seas_spawning_movement redistributes individuals natal spawning regions prior SSB calculation. plus group solved analytically using build_plus_group_T solve_plus_group, ensuring consistent equilibrium solution terminal age class. Effective spawning biomass population's natal region includes contributions populations via straying. Stray contributions scaled stray_rate normalised n_pop_in_region preserve mass balance. Equilibrium recruitment population obtained via Newton-Raphson algorithm solves coupled Beverton-Holt system. Jacobian accounts cross-population dependence spawning biomass induced straying. Total equilibrium yield computed integrating catch--age populations, regions, seasons, scaled equilibrium recruitment origin-region proportions. Recruitment implemented per-recruit process later scaled equilibrium recruitment. Seasonal recruitment proportions applied within first age class, allowing intra-annual timing recruitment movement mortality applied. objective function negative total yield, summed across populations regions. Yield includes landings fleets is_discard_fleet == 0; discard-fleets contribute mortality yield maximised.

title: Compute region-specific Beverton-Holt Fmsy for a spatially explicit single-population model — local_BH_Fmsy_sglpop
text: Cohorts originating region tracked separately seasonal movement, mortality, ageing using [origin, destination] per-recruit accounting framework. Spawning biomass per recruit accumulated origin destination region, plus group solved analytically using build_plus_group_T solve_plus_group. Equilibrium recruitment origin region \(R_{eq,o}\) solved using Newton-Raphson algorithm applied fixed-point condition recruitment produced destination region (via BH relationship applied effective SSB) equals recruitment attributed origin. Jacobian derived analytically using quotient rule chain rule spatial redistribution spawning biomass. Yield computed using landed fraction fishing mortality, excluding fleets flagged discard-via is_discard_fleet. Discard-fleets still contribute total mortality Z affect population dynamics spawning biomass. Fishing mortality decomposed retained discarded components: Retained fishing mortality:     $$F^{\mathrm{ret}}_{r,,s,f} = F_{MSY,r} \, F_{\mathrm{fract},r,s,f} \,           \mathrm{sel}_{r,,s,f} \, \mathrm{ret}_{r,,s,f}$$ Discard fishing mortality (dead discards ):     $$F^{\mathrm{disc}}_{r,,s,f} =           F_{MSY,r} \, F_{\mathrm{fract},r,s,f} \,           \mathrm{sel}_{r,,s,f} \, (1 - \mathrm{ret}_{r,,s,f}) \,           \mathrm{dmr}_{r,s,f}$$ Total instantaneous mortality:     $$Z_{r,,s} = M_{r,} \, \mathrm{seasdur}_s +           F^{\mathrm{ret}}_{r,,s} + F^{\mathrm{disc}}_{r,,s}$$ Landed yield used objective function excludes catch fleets is_discard_fleet == 1. Baranov catch equation partitions landed F total Z, discard fleet's contribution mortality properly accounted denominator. Seasonal movement applied using Movement[origin, dest, seas, age] array. Recruitment may move immediately age-1 depending do_recruits_move. Spawning biomass accumulated spawn_seas fractional mortality t_spawn. plus group solved analytically using transition matrices produced build_plus_group_T solver solve_plus_group.

title: Compute SPR reference point for a single-region or non-spatial model — single_region_SPR
text: **Fishing mortality decomposition** Fishing mortality age split : - retained fishing mortality   F_ret = F * selectivity * retention - discard fishing mortality (dead discards )   F_disc = F * selectivity * (1 - retention) * dmr dmr discard mortality rate (fraction discarded fish die). dead fraction contributes total instantaneous mortality Z. total mortality used survival : Z = M + F_ret + F_disc formulation assumes: - retained fish always die, - fraction dmr discarded fish die, - surviving fraction (1 - dmr) discards remains   population continues aging contributing spawning biomass.
